evidence: Since the United States and Israel launched a war on Iran in late February, the global energy sector has undergone major upheaval.

evidence: Since the United States and Israel launched a war on Iran in late February, the global energy sector has undergone major upheaval.

nary_nodes.label: Oil price swing
evidence: Oil prices have swung from levels not seen since the onset of Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022 to close to where they were before the conflict more than four months ago.

nary_nodes.label: Construction of new pipelines
evidence: “New pipelines will urgently be built. New security arrangements will be put into place, and the buyers of oil from the region will look elsewhere for diversification,” Imsirovic said.

nary_nodes.label: Accelerated shift to renewables
evidence: Another anticipated legacy of the war is an acceleration in countries’ efforts to shift from fossil fuels to renewables, such as wind, solar and hydropower.

nary_nodes.label: Oil market will never be the same
evidence: “The oil market will never be the same, following this conflict,” Adi Imsirovic, a veteran oil trader who lectures at the University of Oxford, told Al Jazeera.

nary_nodes.label: Long‑term concern over Strait of Hormuz transits
evidence: Dan Marks, a research fellow in energy security at the Royal United Services Institute in London, said he expects there to be “long‑term” concern over transits in the strait.

nary_nodes.label: Push to reduce reliance on the Strait of Hormuz
evidence: June Goh, a Singapore‑based senior oil market analyst at Sparta, a commodities data firm, said she anticipates a sustained push by energy producers and consumers alike to reduce their reliance on the strait.

nary_nodes.label: War supercharging global renewables boom
evidence: In April, Simon Stiell, the top United Nations climate official, told a meeting of government officials at the International Energy Agency that the conflict was already “supercharging the global renewables boom”.

nary_nodes.label: China will benefit from shift away from fossil fuels
evidence: The war has provided an “object lesson in the value of a much more diversified energy mix”, said Maurice Obstfeld, a senior fellow at the Peterson Institute for International Economics and a former chief economist at the International Monetary Fund.

nary_nodes.label: US strengthens its position as swing LNG supplier
evidence: “The US strengthens its position as a swing LNG supplier. Qatar consolidates its role as a reliable long‑term contract partner.”

nary_nodes.label: Shift to EVs after war
evidence: “Following this war, few people looking for a new car will opt for one with an internal combustion engine,” Oxford University’s Imsirovic said.

nary_nodes.label: Oil monopoly in road transport will end
evidence: “And this will finish the important monopoly of oil in road transportation,” Imsirovic said.

nary_nodes.label: Medium to long‑term economic case for renewables will strengthen
evidence: “While energy security imperatives are likely to lead many governments to stockpile fossil fuels in the near‑term, the medium to long‑term economic case for renewables will strengthen as geopolitical risk inflates ‘the true cost’ of fossil fuel dependence,” said Mohamed Elheddad.

type_definitions.definition: A sovereign nation-state with defined territory and government.
An organized group of people with a specific purpose, such as a university, research institute, or media outlet.
An individual human being, typically mentioned by name.
A system of pipes used to transport oil, gas, or other fluids over long distances.
A natural physical feature of the Earth's surface.
The part of the global economy dealing with production, distribution, and consumption of energy resources.
A market where energy commodities such as oil, gas, or electricity are bought and sold.
A technology used to generate, store, or deliver energy, especially renewable sources.
A span of time identified by a month, season, or descriptive phrase.

relation_definitions.definition: An entity took part in a particular event.
An event took place during a specific time period.
An event produced or triggered another event.
An event comprised or contained a sub‑event or element.
A claim or statement was expressed by a particular person.
The subject of a claim or statement concerns a particular entity or topic.
A claim or statement is linked to a specific event.
A party committed to guaranteeing safe navigation within a waterway.
A party asserted authority over a particular geographic feature.
A country utilizes a pipeline to transport exports.
An event or plan includes a specific pipeline as a component.
An organization reported a record level of capacity for a given year.
An organization manufactures a large proportion of a product category.
